reference: F.mish(x) in f64, rounded once to the dtype
notes: NaN propagates. Expected NaN must be NaN (any NaN matches any NaN) and expected ±inf must be the same inf. -inf gives NaN (-inf · 0), as in torch. out is computed in f64 from the inputs and params and rounded once to the dtype under test, so the bytes don't depend on the CPU's kernels; torch in the dtype itself meets the tolerance (checked by the generator).
